notes.title: The Lost Surreal Hell Second Route Update is out!!
notes.content:
It is Halloween, which means today is the day the Lost Surreal Hell Second Route Update is out.
This update introduces the "Second Route".
The Second Route ended up turning out a little different than planned, taking place within the surreal hell instead of outside of it.

The earliest a player can reach the second route, is by the time they reach the village area. Be warned however, as entering this route will lock you in and prevent you from accessing the rest of the game until it is beaten. 

- Implemented the torn tie route!

- 5 new battles!

- 11 new areas!

- Kraftia is finally in Lost Surreal Hell and implemented as intended!

notes.title: Difficulty patch
notes.content:
The primary change made in this patch is the lowering of difficulty for all Lost Surreal Hell battles.
Every time a fight is lost, the player will gain a level, making the fight easier.
This change doesn't apply to hard mode.

A bug where loading save data from older versions of Lost Surreal Hell causes a crash was also fixed.

notes.title: The Preparation Update
notes.content:
The Preparation Update, as the name suggests is an update released to prepare for the big "Second Route Update" coming along on Halloween.

Changes:

- Tie Fence loop segments expanded upon, new areas and content.

- New UI in fights to make figuring out how to effectively evade attacks easier.

- Blue Tie fight is slightly easier.

- New Level Up screen.

- Text now types out instead of all appearing at once. (contemplated heavily about adding this one)

notes.title: The Second Route Update will be out on Halloween!
notes.content:
Lost Surreal Hell is a game that while complete, is missing the ability to not enter the surreal hell in the first place.

The "Second Route" will become available only in hard mode.

Experience what the world is like normally in Lost Surreal Hell with the Second Route Update!

WELCOME TO [strike]LOST SURREAL[/strike] HELL!

Featuring: 
- Party members that you can take into battles!
- New wave of skill evolutions!
- Horrors that will never stop following you... 
- A LOT More from specifically these guys:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43780243/6b4b40ce885b138d6abfbb476ca59529e72bfca3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43780243/8c1d1aa3e5682aa25b2cf1bafde70e06d5c6215c.png[/img]


Lost Surreal Hell has much unused content within it's files, including areas, dialogue,
an entire 2d game about mining and building from when the KRAFTIA project merged with Lost Surreal Hell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43780243/da4ce97a5d877e56a580a7bc8422161a0300ef07.png[/img]

It's got a gun clicker mini game in it, a 2d fighter, those who have been following my games will recognise this character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43780243/bf0fc2fa2e1a9ec1b91f59177542a1cd8b14653c.png[/img]

A 3d block placement platformer.
I will not reveal anything else about these segments, expect them to be in the Second Route Update in the original way they were meant to be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43780243/55cdba4b5b911bd4aef676d053f27032bbef8a2b.png[/img]

It's also got a bunch of unused OST.

Enjoy it!

But not the wait until Halloween for the update.

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
- Flashing effects toned down.

- Zoom effect when transitioning has been toned down.

- New key indicator for X.

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
- Fighting Red Tie is slightly easier now.

- An icon will now tell you if your moves will miss, but only in normal mode.

- New village Green Tie encounter, this Green Tie will hint to you how to leave the village.
